title: Make a K-pop stage video
description: Choose a set on the second floor and record a short performance together.
question: Is the second-floor stage available now? How long is the wait to film?
korean: 지금 2층 무대에서 촬영할 수 있나요? 촬영하려면 몇 분 정도 기다려야 하나요?

title: Take a photo at HiKR Street
description: The third-floor street set has a replica bus stop where you can take a photo together.
question: Can we use the bus-stop photo spot on the third floor now? Is there a wait?
korean: 지금 3층 버스 정류장 포토존에서 사진을 찍을 수 있나요? 대기가 있나요?

title: Walk beside Cheonggyecheon
description: Use the Gwanggyo stair entrance for a short walk by the water. Check stream access before going down.
question: Is the Gwanggyo stair entrance to the stream open today?
korean: 지금 청계천 광교 계단 진입로로 내려갈 수 있나요? 통제 중인 구간이 있나요?
